title: A Fog in London Killed Thousands in Four Days

scenes.text: A fog in London killed thousands of people in just four days.
It started on December 5th, 1952, when cold air trapped coal smoke over the city.
In back streets, you could barely see a metre in front of you.
Every form of public transport except the Underground stopped.
The smog crept indoors, and concerts and film shows were called off because no one could see the stage or screen.
The government counted about 4,000 deaths. Later studies said around 12,000.
